raw.query: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.runs r JOIN provenance.llm_run_summary l USING (run_id) WHERE r.experiment='reactive' AND r.pool='language' AND r.is_current AND l.mean_ttft_ms < 500 AND l.mean_itl_ms < 50 AND l.p99_ttft_ms > 1000) AS verified_lang_configs, (SELECT min(l.p99_ttft_ms) || ' to ' || max(l.p99_ttft_ms) FROM provenance.runs r JOIN provenance.llm_run_summary l USING (run_id) WHERE r.experiment='reactive' AND r.pool='language' AND r.is_current) AS lang_p99_range, (SELECT min(gpu_hours) || ' to ' || max(gpu_hours) FROM provenance.v_pool_cost WHERE experiment = 'riders' AND run_id LIKE 'riders:ladder%' AND is_current) AS riders_gpu_hours_range, (SELECT min(p99_ms) || ' to ' || max(p99_ms) FROM provenance.v_pool_latency WHERE experiment = 'riders' AND run_id LIKE 'riders:ladder%' AND is_current AND sla_metric='ttft') AS riders_p99_range, (SELECT count(*) FROM provenance.factorial_cell WHERE policy='reactive' AND rho=15 AND lead_s=300 AND window_name='burst3' AND NOT feasible) AS burst3_L300_fails, (SELECT achieved_p99_ms FROM provenance.v_dim d JOIN provenance.v_infraction i USING (run_id) WHERE d.experiment='reactive' AND d.pool='encoder' AND d.window_name='burst6' AND d.lead_s=300 AND d.is_current AND i.is_current AND i.sla_metric='encoder_delay') AS burst6_L300_p99
raw.observed: verified_lang_configs: 14/14 meet 500/50ms mean targets while violating p99 TTFT SLA (range 1079.2 to 3494.7 ms); riders ladder GPU-hours rise monotonically from 18.64 to 20.38 but p99 TTFT remains pinned at 1615.5 to 1619.6 ms; encoder reactive fails when onset < lead: burst3 L300 violates (p99 54169.5 ms) and burst6 L300 violates (p99 4606.1 ms)
raw.claimed: 14 language-pool configs meet window-mean law but violate tail SLA; increased spend cannot buy tail back under lead; reactive encoder control loses every window where onset is faster than lead.
raw.evidence: 14/14 reactive language configs meet mean SLA but violate tail SLA; riders target ladder spend rises with tighter targets but tail remains pinned; reactive encoder runs with onset < lead (burst3 and burst6 at L300) fail tail SLA.
